# SHIELD Scientific

> > SHIELD Scientific is a global manufacturer of high-performance protective gloves for laboratory, cleanroom, and chemical handling applications, featuring proprietary technologies like twinSHIELD and SMARTLine product ranges.

The company specializes in nitrile and latex gloves meeting Category III PPE standards under EU Regulation 2016/425, serving scientific and industrial markets worldwide through an extensive distributor network across Americas, Asia, and Europe. SHIELD Scientific offers innovative tools like the Glove Comparator and SHIELDyou chemical safety poster maker to help customers select appropriate hand protection.

## Key Topics

- Nitrile gloves
- Chemical protection
